execution_prescriptions: Concatenate all pages against the captured bounded result, including metadata/tokens; preserve terminal reasons and whole-path atomicity.
First checkpoint must hold actual G1 SQLite and pack across G2/G3 publication/prune, prove pending/active/state/FD accounting and reject capacity before issuance; no early eviction or live fallback.
Execute cross-chunk/EOF/empty/post-acquisition tamper controls and measure complete SDK result/next URI/base64 and fixed ErrorData caps, not just raw bytes.
Preserve three-day allocation and early native ownership/quota proof; do not expand to a persistent retention service or resumable BFS.
Real parser/SQLite/SDK/host-Docker cancellation, idle expiry, shutdown/restart and scope forgery controls remain mandatory; archived SDK primitive does not prove product authorization/retention.
limitations: Plan approval only; integrated issuance, registry capacity, cleanup, source chunk integrity and current producer evidence remain execution verification.
